programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: After an eleven-year estrangement, Jordan and his father, Adonis, have recently reconnected; for the first time, they'll travel to Adonis' home country of Cuba for Jordan to discover their family's rich musical legacy.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Cameras capture an entire city floating in the sky; a signal comes from under a tiny island off the coast of Africa; a powerful radio beam from deep space reaches Earth only to vanish and never return.

programs.title: Nintendo 64 Quest
programs.desc: Jay and Rob travel to Indiana to meet up with an old friend in hopes of solving their newly discovered problem.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: A team of experts breaks down significant disasters in history, including the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, the Suez Canal blockage, the California wildfires of 2020, the 1970 Yungay, Peru, avalanche, and the bombings of Hiroshima.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan, Canada is home to tunnels that sprawl underneath most of the city's downtown; while much of the system has been converted into a tourist attraction, some residue of the spirit realm still clings onto the space; the guys talk with a local psychic medium who corroborates the paranormal stories that some employees have experienced and gives clues as to where to look in the tunnel system; a sensory deprivation session in the catacombs leads to a experience that defies logic.
